mapper.select: SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, price_vnd AS priceVnd, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan WHERE plan_code=#{planCode} AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_ref=#{sourceRef} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE source_type=#{sourceType} AND source_ref=#{sourceRef} LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, price_vnd AS priceVnd, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan WHERE status='ACTIVE' ORDER BY id ASC

SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, price_vnd AS priceVnd, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan ORDER BY id DESC

SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, price_vnd AS priceVnd, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan WHERE id=#{planId} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, plan_code AS planCode, plan_name AS planName, price_vnd AS priceVnd, tickets_per_period AS ticketsPerPeriod, period_months AS periodMonths, ticket_validity_days AS ticketValidityDays, status, version FROM reading_subscription_plan WHERE plan_code=#{planCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_plan (plan_code, plan_name, price_vnd, tickets_per_period, period_months, ticket_validity_days, status) VALUES (#{command.planCode}, #{command.planName}, #{command.priceVnd}, #{command.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{command.periodMonths}, #{command.ticketValidityDays}, 'DRAFT')
mapper.update: UPDATE reading_subscription_plan SET plan_name=#{command.planName}, price_vnd=#{command.priceVnd}, tickets_per_period=#{command.ticketsPerPeriod}, period_months=#{command.periodMonths}, ticket_validity_days=#{command.ticketValidityDays}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{planId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status<>'RETIRED' AND plan_code=#{command.planCode}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED') ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT grant_row.id, grant_row.subscription_id AS subscriptionId, grant_row.user_id AS userId, grant_row.period_start AS periodStart, grant_row.period_end AS periodEnd, grant_row.ticket_amount AS ticketAmount, grant_row.ticket_expire_at AS ticketExpireAt, grant_row.create_time AS createTime FROM reading_subscription_period_grant grant_row INNER JOIN user_reading_subscription subscription_row ON subscription_row.id=grant_row.subscription_id AND subscription_row.user_id=#{userId} WHERE grant_row.subscription_id=#{subscriptionId} ORDER BY grant_row.period_start DESC, grant_row.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_reading_subscription (user_id, plan_id, plan_code_snapshot, tickets_per_period_snapshot, period_months_snapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot, start_at, next_grant_at, end_at, status, source_type, source_ref, policy_version) VALUES (#{command.userId}, #{plan.id}, #{plan.planCode}, #{plan.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{plan.periodMonths}, #{plan.ticketValidityDays}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.endAt}, 'ACTIVE', #{command.sourceType}, #{command.sourceRef}, #{command.policyVersion})

INSERT INTO user_reading_subscription (user_id, plan_id, plan_code_snapshot, tickets_per_period_snapshot, period_months_snapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot, start_at, next_grant_at, end_at, status, source_type, source_ref, policy_version) SELECT #{command.userId}, #{command.planId}, #{command.planCode}, #{command.ticketsPerPeriod}, #{command.periodMonths}, #{command.ticketValidityDays}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.startAt}, #{command.endAt}, 'ACTIVE', 'PAYMENT', #{command.sourceRef}, #{command.policyVersion} FROM DUAL WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE user_id=#{command.userId} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'PAUSED') )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, plan_id AS planId, plan_code_snapshot AS planCodeSnapshot, tickets_per_period_snapshot AS ticketsPerPeriodSnapshot, period_months_snapshot AS periodMonthsSnapshot, ticket_validity_days_snapshot AS ticketValidityDaysSnapshot, start_at AS startAt, next_grant_at AS nextGrantAt, end_at AS endAt, status, source_type AS sourceType, source_ref AS sourceRef, policy_version AS policyVersion, version FROM user_reading_subscription WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND next_grant_at<=#{now} AND (end_at IS NULL OR next_grant_at<end_at) LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reading_subscription_period_grant (subscription_id, user_id, period_start, period_end, ticket_amount, ticket_expire_at, reading_ticket_ledger_id, idempotency_key, policy_version) SELECT #{subscriptionId}, #{userId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{ticketAmount}, #{ticketExpireAt}, id, #{idempotencyKey}, policy_version FROM reading_ticket_ledger WHERE idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE user_reading_subscription SET next_grant_at=#{nextGrantAt}, status=#{nextStatus}, version=version+1 WHERE id=#{subscriptionId} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='ACTIVE'
